Which of the following statement is TRUE?
options: Computer vision focuses on low-level operations such as filtering and noise reduction, while image processing involves high-level understanding and decision-making from visual data.
Computer vision and image processing are the same and used interchangeably in the context of analyzing visual data.
Computer vision aims to interpret and make decisions based on visual data, while image processing involves manipulating and transforming pixel data in images.
Image processing focuses on understanding and interpreting images, while computer vision involves operations like noise reduction and edge detection.
correct: Computer vision aims to interpret and make decisions based on visual data, while image processing involves manipulating and transforming pixel data in images.
